  x                3 collections, consistent with its own chain

bound in force: 64 MiB a line (--max-line-bytes)

What a pass shows: each log is hash-chained and checkable against itself and its anchor: every
entry holds the digest of its content, every link names the entry before it, and the last entry is
the one the anchor names. It does not show who wrote a log or when, that what it records is true,
or that whoever holds both a log and its anchor did not rewrite both.
